    Finding the most valuable media has been a maze.
    Optable is creating a clear path forward.

    Optable’s Agentic Marketplace, Audience, and Identity products stand on their own. Start with the challenges worth solving now, connect to the systems you already use, and add capabilities without starting over. The same signal foundation powers it all.

    See how it all works →

    Optable Agentic Marketplace

    Turn new demand into revenue, on your terms

    Your highest-value inventory shouldn’t disappear because it lives in decks, inboxes, or the head of a seller. Build your audience products into a storefront buyer agents can find and transact on.

    • Sell what sets you apart. Package sponsorships, premium video, CTV, in-app, custom audiences, and other direct products with the context buyers need.
    • Choose exactly what you expose. Define who can see a product, how it is priced, and what rules apply before it ever reaches the marketplace.
    • Be found when the brief arrives. Let buyer agents discover relevant products the moment intent enters the market, not days after outreach begins.

    Any brief. One front door to premium publishers.

    Let a buyer agent carry campaign intent across participating publishers, return comparable direct opportunities, and keep the media path transparent.

    • Work directly with publisher data. Collaborate around publisher-owned signals while protecting the underlying data.
    • Compare offers with context intact. See the publisher, audience signal, product, price, and availability in every proposal.
    • Buy premium inventory direct. Get access to takeovers, sponsorships, and video opportunities the open auction never sees, at the publisher’s price.

    Optable Audience

    Build audiences buyers can’t get anywhere else

    Your advantage is the signal only you can see. Bring identity, behavior, context, intent, inventory, and partner data together so planning teams can turn these rich signals into differentiated audience products faster.

    • Respond while the brief is live. Move from an RFP to sized audience recommendations in minutes instead of days.
    • Make first-party data more useful. Enrich with interest, intent, contextual, behavioral, and partner signals matched with what you already know.
    • Activate where buyers transact. Sync audiences into the ad server, SSPs, DSPs, and curation workflows already in your stack.

    Build better audiences on the data you own

    Your best audience strategy starts with you and your clients’ data. Optable helps you onboard, enrich, and expand that data without renting another segment for every campaign.

    • Start with owned data. Match customer records and build from the signals your client already has.
    • Fill the gaps with enrichment. Layer in demographic, interest, intent, and contextual signals so your strategy doesn’t hinge on first-party data.
    • Keep the margin. Stop paying a data fee every time a rented segment runs.

    Optable Identity

    Turn more of your audience into revenue

    Most of your visitors never log in. Optable recognizes them anyway. They’re resolved to a graph you own that grows and adapts with every property you add, so more of your inventory sells as addressable.

    • Recover addressability. Recognize anonymous traffic and connect it to the identifiers buyers already bid on.
    • See the same person on every screen. Maintain one profile across your channels and properties, so a buy can follow them.
    • Your graph, your rules. Decide how identity is built and used, with no proprietary ID to build around.

    Reach more of the customers you already know

    Reach should not disappear when cookies, device IDs, or logins are unavailable. Optable resolves across multiple identity spaces at once, so more of your customers stay reachable on the media you buy.

    • Higher match rates. Find customers missing from one ID space in another.
    • Every screen. Reach people on CTV, app, and audio, where no one logs in.
    • No lock-in. Choose which providers you use, without depending on any one ID or paying per-impression fees tied to it.

    One vendor, one contract

    Resolve identity, package your audiences, and sell to agentic demand.

    Resolve everywhere

    Every visitor gets resolved, across web, app, audio, and CTV, in real time through Optable ID Switchboard. More resolved impressions means more inventory you can sell at full value.

    Package quickly

    Optable Audience Agent turns a brief into a sized, priced segment in minutes, without a week of manual work. Collaborate without exposing raw data in an Optable clean room, not a separate vendor’s.

    Sell agentically

    Enrich your data so buyer agents have a clear signal. Optable Sales Agent negotiates and closes against your rules over AdCP, the open protocol Optable helped found, so revenue can keep flowing.

    Match everywhere

    Bring your first-party data to Optable ID Switchboard and match it against resolved identity across web, app, audio, and CTV, so you reach a person rather than a cookie.

    Build quickly

    Optable Audience Agent turns your brief into a sized, priced audience in minutes. Model lookalikes inside an Optable clean room without exposing raw data to anyone.

    Buy agentically

    Discover and negotiate premium inventory over AdCP, the open protocol Optable helped found, so your agents close against your rules without a manual RFP.
